purpose: Independent Narrative Craft V21 data-freeze approval.

scope.assessment: Data integrity, correction support, selection and preservation. Detector performance is outside this audit.
scope.method: Direct source inspection and deterministic local verification. Additional reviewer delegation was excluded by the task.
scope.inputs: Global/repository AGENTS and writing internal-document guides; public dataset loader/schema; permitted data-review, allocation, correction, quota and copy-screen receipts; selector, packer and overlap scripts; source pools, backups, curator decisions, selections, definitions and addition reviews for DEV 000117 and 000123.
scope.protectedProcessing: All 52 root pairs were processed for schema, hashes and aggregate counts. The unaffected 50 pairs were compared with captured Git bytes; only counts were emitted.
scope.excludedInputs: Prompt files, detector results, full taxonomy, other dataset contents and root tuning record.
scope.semanticReviewBoundary: Verified the explicit 11-correction receipt and four additions' author/three-blind-review agreement. Existing source-pool labels were checked mechanically.

provenance.explanation: The corrected archive preserves all 243 original 000117 passages and all 240 original 000123 passages, plus four additions. The only original-label changes are the 11 agreed corrections.

verifiedAssertions: All 52 pairs pass the public dataset loader/schema, including text checksums, sample boundaries, global passage-ID uniqueness, passage/check uniqueness and exact snippet containment.
All 80 collection/check assignments have exactly 100 hits and 100 no-hits. All 50 reported selections have root vector counts equal to their recorded quotas.
Both changed root texts, boundaries and labels match their frozen selections. Every selected row exactly matches its corrected source and Git full-pool archive.
Source backups and previous selections match receipt hashes and the original Git datasets. All original source writing survives unchanged.
All 11 corrections are selected. Previous/current values and snippets match the unanimous receipt, including three matching votes for each correction.
All four additions are selected verbatim. Their blind input contains IDs/text only; all 36 judgments match the author labels, with 12 exact hit-snippet occurrences.
Every mandatory row survives: 90 in 000117 and 70 in 000123. Fresh selector recomputation reproduces frozen row order, retention records and report strata.
The original SHA-256 ranking formula and priority order are unchanged. All 23 recorded selection-input hashes for the changed collections match current inputs.
Read-time/pre-output stability guards, exact archive proof, frozen-source/input checks, explicit 100-hit assertions and mandatory-row assertions remain operational.

Collection 000117 uses model:null in its composite source/selection and omits source.model from archive/root metadata; the public schema permits omission. Collection 000123 retains its original model attribution.

quotaVerification.initialStop: Independent quota-review receipt records inspection-needed: 27 mandatory rows in cell 000 exceeded uniform quota 25.
quotaVerification.approvedResolution: Minimum-deviation quotas retain all mandatory rows, 200 passages and each check's exact 100/100 margins.
quotaVerification.freshEnumeration: Separate eight-cell enumeration finds 31 feasible vectors at radius 2 and exactly one minimum-L1 vector: [27,24,24,25,24,25,25,26]. Radius 0 and 1 cannot accommodate mandatory 27.
quotaVerification.acceptance: Independent approval explicitly preserves per-check 95/5; the selector changes sampling quotas only.

selectorVerification.full50Evidence: Current data-review selectionVerification hashes match the inspected selector and completed report. All 50 collections are ready with 200 selected rows; skipped, inspection-needed, replenishment-needed and unproven changes are zero.
selectorVerification.full50CompletionBasis: Report-backed completed recomputation. The inspected successful report path follows frozen-row/input/archive comparisons and exits 0. Main also reports full-50 recomputation exit 0.

freshReadOnlyRecomputation.result: Exact match with frozen selections and full-report entries. Filesystem writes were intercepted; source, selections and report remained unchanged.

additionReviewVerification.evidence: Author/review hashes match the correction record. Declared reviewer inputs contain global instructions, internal-writing guides, extracted definitions and label-free blind input.
additionReviewVerification.objectionReview: Reviewers distinguish interchangeable perception beats from useful surrounding physical tasks and concrete observations. Their recorded concerns preserve those controls and agree with the final labels.

copyScreenVerification.method: Hash-bound receipt verification and comparison of verifier source. Reference-corpus scans remain recorded evidence.
copyScreenVerification.originalScreenBindings: 48 unchanged allocation pairs match current hashes; the two revised development pairs match original Git 2eef62d6 hashes.
copyScreenVerification.thresholdEvidence: Tokenization, short-passage Levenshtein logic and comparison functions are byte-identical: normalized exact equality; >=10 shared five-word shingles with Jaccard >=0.2 or containment >=0.5; unchanged under-20-token fallback.

globalDatasetValidator.evidence: Completed result supplied by main. Additions receipt also records 15773 prior documents; this audit freshly validates the permitted 52 family pairs.

fixture3GenericReaderContract.evidence: Main's completion message; suite artifacts are outside the permitted inputs.

verifiedObjections.question: Did quotas discard hard controls or weaken class balance?
verifiedObjections.result: Initial overflow stopped selection. Independent math and fresh recomputation retain all 160 mandatory rows, 200 rows per collection and exact per-check 100/100 margins.

verifiedObjections.question: Did refreezing lose original selected writing?
verifiedObjections.result: 389 of 400 old selected passages remain selected. The 11 omitted rows retain exact text and labels in Git 87a1accc; all 483 original source passages retain their writing.

verifiedObjections.question: Does the old copy screen bind revised root hashes?
verifiedObjections.result: It binds the original frozen selections. Four additions have a separate hash-bound zero-candidate receipt; the report preserves those distinct evidence scopes.

verifiedObjections.question: Does composite 000117 falsely inherit the original generator model?
verifiedObjections.result: The four new subagent model identifiers are unavailable. The null sentinel suppresses source.model in corrected archive/current metadata; schema validation passes.

completion: Data freeze approved within the stated evidence scope. Model runs can use these frozen datasets under their separate authorization.

metadataFinalization.proof: Reversing only the final status value reproduces the previous data-review byte hash. Replacing that one hash in the final 151-input manifest reproduces the previous manifest; all other source, dataset, selection and receipt inputs are unchanged.
metadataFinalization.inputStability: Final data-review bytes were captured before the verifier and compared byte-for-byte afterward. The verifier also rechecked all 151 captured inputs.
metadataFinalization.dependencyDirection: The audit hashes the final data-review bytes. Main keeps its audit acknowledgment in the excluded tuning record.
